# Saylor University

> > Saylor University is a free, open online learning platform offering degree programs, specializations, and courses across multiple disciplines.

Saylor University provides accessible online education through a comprehensive catalog of courses and degree programs spanning arts, humanities, business, computer science, and social sciences. The platform supports student enrollment and navigation across diverse subject areas with flexible, self-paced learning options.

## Key Topics

- Degree Programs
- Course Catalog
- Specialization Programs
- Online Learning Platform
- Free Education
- Business Administration
- Computer Science
- Arts and Humanities
- Science and Mathematics
- Social Science
- Professional Development
- Student Support
- Course Navigation
- Enrollment
- Administrative or Virtual Assistant Specialization
